description: Reports and Analytics Dashboard: new backend endpoint /api/reports/overview returning aggregated stats (total applications, counts by status/constituency/bursary with amounts); new frontend ReportsPage component with summary cards, tables for Applications by Constituency/Status/Bursary using existing styling patterns and simple HTML/CSS progress bars (no external chart libraries)
steps: Backend: In backend/app/main.py, add new endpoint after existing /api/reports/applications.csv endpoint (around line 599). Create `@app.get("/api/reports/overview")` with `user: User = Depends(require_roles("admin","reviewer"))`. Query database for: total_applications = db.scalar(select(func.count(Application.id))), approved_count (status='Approved'), rejected_count (status='Rejected'), pending_count (not in Approved/Rejected/Disbursed), disbursed_count (status='Disbursed'). For breakdown by constituency: query `db.execute(select(Bursary.constituency, func.count(Application.id).label('total_apps'), func.sum(case((Application.status=='Approved',1),else_=0)).label('approved'), func.sum(case((Application.status=='Disbursed',Application.bursary.amount_kes),else_=0)).label('total_amount')).join(Application.bursary).group_by(Bursary.constituency)).all()`. Return JSON with structure: `{"total_applications": int, "approved": int, "rejected": int, "pending": int, "disbursed": int, "by_constituency": [{"name": str, "total_apps": int, "approved": int, "pending": int, "disbursed": int, "total_amount": int}], "by_status": [{"status": str, "count": int}], "by_bursary": [{"bursary_name": str, "total_apps": int, "approved": int, "avg_amount": float}]}`

Frontend: In frontend/src/App.jsx, locate the existing ReportsPage component (around line 1180). This component currently shows only 4 stat cards and a status summary with CSV export. Replace the entire component body with: PageHeading (eyebrow='ANALYTICS DASHBOARD', title='Reports & Analytics', desc='Overview of application metrics and allocation tracking', action=CSV export button). Add state: `const [overview,setOverview]=useState(null)`. Add useEffect to fetch on mount: `useEffect(()=>{loadOverview()},[])` with `async function loadOverview(){try{const data=await api('/reports/overview');setOverview(data)}catch(e){console.error(e)}}`. Display loading state if !overview. Render summary cards: Total Applications (overview.total_applications, green), Approval Rate % (Math.round(overview.approved/(overview.total_applications||1)*100), blue), Total Disbursed Amount (money(overview.by_constituency.reduce((sum,c)=>sum+c.total_amount,0)), purple), Pending Review (overview.pending, amber)

Continue ReportsPage: Add table 'Applications by Constituency' in a panel.table-panel. Use existing table markup pattern from ApplicationsPage. Columns: Constituency, Total Applications, Approved, Pending, Approval Rate %. Map over overview.by_constituency array. Calculate approval_rate as Math.round(c.approved/c.total_apps*100). Show simple progress bar using existing .bar-track/.bar-track i pattern from Dashboard (see line ~1150): `
`

Continue ReportsPage: Add second table 'Applications by Status' showing overview.by_status entries. Columns: Status, Count, Percentage. Calculate percentage as Math.round(s.count/overview.total_applications*100). Include inline progress bar similar to constituency table. Add third table 'Applications by Bursary' showing overview.by_bursary entries. Columns: Bursary Name, Total Applications, Approved, Average Amount. Display avg_amount using money() formatter

Verification: ensure ReportsPage is already in staff navigation (line ~67: `['reports','Reports',ArrowDownToLine]`). Test by signing in as admin, clicking Reports in sidebar. Should see 4 summary cards, 3 tables with real data from database, no external chart libraries used (only CSS progress bars). Verify CSV export button still works from existing implementation
acceptance_criteria: Backend endpoint /api/reports/overview returns JSON with total_applications, approved, rejected, pending, disbursed counts; by_constituency array with name/total_apps/approved/pending/disbursed/total_amount; by_status array with status/count; by_bursary array with bursary_name/total_apps/approved/avg_amount
Frontend ReportsPage displays 4 summary cards: Total Applications, Approval Rate %, Total Disbursed Amount, Pending Review count
ReportsPage shows table 'Applications by Constituency' with columns: name, total, approved, pending, approval rate %, and inline CSS progress bars
ReportsPage shows table 'Applications by Status' with status name, count, percentage, and progress bars
ReportsPage shows table 'Applications by Bursary' with bursary name, total apps, approved count, average amount
No external chart libraries added; uses existing HTML/CSS progress bars (.bar-track pattern from Dashboard)
verification: Start backend: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1 && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
Test backend endpoint directly: open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs, authorize as admin, execute GET /api/reports/overview, verify JSON structure matches specification
Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev
Sign in as admin@smartbursary.com (password from .env, default ChangeMe123!)
Verify 4 stat cards appear at top with real numbers from database
Verify table 'Applications by Constituency' appears with data rows and progress bars showing approval rates
Verify table 'Applications by Status' shows all statuses with counts and percentages
Verify table 'Applications by Bursary' shows bursary names with application counts and amounts
Verify CSV export button still works (downloads smartbursary-applications.csv)
